summary: Bound suspension companion content before archiving and remove failed payload staging files

schema.detail: Snapshot manifests and archive formats are unchanged.

rules.detail: Sealing counts transcript, workspace bundle and companion-directory regular-file content together against the existing 256 MiB cap before packing. Transcript and bundle sizes follow symlinks. Companion traversal uses an explicit stack with one directory iterator open at a time, at most 128 levels below its root and 100,000 entries including its root; violations report snapshot-depth-limit or snapshot-entry-limit. The final archive-size check still includes archive overhead.

compatibility.detail: Existing complete snapshots remain readable. Companion symlinks are not followed during size accounting or archiving. New captures exceeding the companion traversal limits fail before archive creation.

downtime.detail: The fix applies to subsequent sealing attempts after binary replacement.

manual.detail: No new commands or configuration. Existing staging debris is not swept by this change.

recovery.detail: A failed sealing attempt removes its payload.tmp staging file, including when archive publication or the final size check fails. Workspace capture and native-session files are retained for retry.
